response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT BillingState, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_above_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
